## 💜 Soul-Dex 1.2.3: Out of the Shadows

*Every pact has terms. Ours are now written plainly, for all to read.*

**What's new**

- **Open source.** Soul-Dex's code is now public on GitHub. Read it, report bugs and suggest ideas in the issues.
- **GPLv3 licence.** Soul-Dex is now licensed under the GNU GPL v3 (it was MIT), the same licence as the Questie raid data it ships.
- **A new name in the addon list.** Soul-Dex now calls itself "A collection dex for your Soul Shards".
- **No gameplay changes.** Your dex, points and settings are untouched.

**Install:** download `SoulDex-v1.2.3-forever.zip` below and unzip it into `Interface\AddOns`, replacing your old `SoulDex` folder, then `/reload`. No new files this time, so no full restart needed.

*The contract is signed. Now go fill some shards.*
